project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:171
Multiple ENTRYPOINT instructions were found. Only the last one will take effect.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): the two ENTRYPOINT instructions sit in separate final stages (final-core at line 155, final-full at line 171, each FROM rules); each stage has exactly one effective entrypoint, the rule cannot see stage boundaries
